sections.Profile:
The "Ten Spot" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in June 1961, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Nightlife, Original Theme, Music, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions: - Ten Spot: 900 made, released 1961-06-01, model number 250
